{{Top|leg}}
The '''Southern Passage''' was a sea to the south of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was frequented by [[Alanciari]] fishermen who plied its waters for seafood. In [[2975 BBY]], the surviving members of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Edell Vrai]]'s ill-fated [[mission to Alanciar]] used the Southern Passage to return to [[Keshtah Minor]] by the [[Sea of Flames]]. They used the Alanciari harvester ''[[Mischance]]'' for this journey and also brought the Alanciari signals officer [[Jogan Halder]] with them.
